name: EPIC 212324691
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 7.3 solar radii and 1.14 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,988 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 1.14 solar masses and 7.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,944 K at its surface.
